title: DRY Principle
description: Don't Repeat Yourself - eliminate duplicate code.

data.text: **DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself)** is a software development principle aimed at reducing repetition. Every piece of knowledge should have a single, unambiguous representation.

items: Data duplication: Same data in multiple places
Logic duplication: Same algorithm implemented differently

data.title: Before and After DRY
data.content: Refactor duplicated code into reusable methods

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Extract common logic into reusable methods
Single source of truth for business rules
data.takeaway: DRY code is easier to maintain and less error-prone.
